When this file is a relationship, dependency, lineage or architecture diagram (or its data), keep it in the neural graph look:
follow [the Copilot instructions](../copilot-instructions.md), [the design spec](../../docs/DESIGN-SPEC.md) and [the data schema](../../docs/DATA-SCHEMA.md).
Ignore this for files that are not diagrams.
